svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut ten lengths of 300 from 32 x 3 fibreglass tube; round and seal the ends

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill a 10 hole straight across at mid length (150 from each end)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sling: 1.2 m of 6 mm cord through the hole, tied into a loop with a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: double fisherman's knot that sits under the toggle

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hitch the loop to the pull rope with a three-turn prusik hitch

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (it slides when loose and grips when pulled)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Space the toggles 1 m apart, the first 11 m from the hook head

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: hang 30 kg on one toggle; the prusik must not slip
